title: Read artifact
guidance: format records (the default) is the mandatory file-first structured read: JSON/NDJSON uses a fixed 4096-byte initial probe, returns records only when the complete result fits, otherwise fails with RESULT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and export details instead of returning nextCursor (then page it with format jsonl or csv, or export it with dsagent.execution.artifact.export when you can read files on the browser machine; for records the caller cannot supply a byte budget). format jsonl or csv pages a structured dataset to its end for a caller that cannot read exported files (a sandboxed or remote agent): each page holds whole records within pageBytes (at most 65536) as JSON Lines or CSV lines with the columns once in header, and nextCursor continues until eof; a record larger than the page is named, never split. Binary artifacts retain fixed bounded Base64 cursor reads for compatibility and can also be exported.

artifactId.description: Opaque artifact identifier returned by dsagent.artifacts.list.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by a prior read of the same artifact and format; omit for the first read.

format.description: records (default): the complete records inline when they fit the fixed probe, else export. jsonl: pages of JSON Lines, one record per line. csv: pages of CSV lines under the dataset columns (header). jsonl and csv apply to structured artifacts only.

pageBytes.description: With format jsonl or csv: the most bytes of records one page holds (default 65536); records never split across pages.

inputSchema.description: Input for bounded reading of a listed execution artifact. For format records the byte budget is fixed by the Extension and is not caller-controlled; jsonl and csv take pageBytes.

format.description: Present on a paged text read: the format of page.

cursor.description: Cursor consumed by this read; empty for the first page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next bounded page (binary, jsonl or csv), or null at EOF.

eof.description: Whether the complete artifact has been consumed.

records.description: Complete structured records returned only when they fit the fixed initial probe (format records).

page.description: format jsonl: the records of this page, one JSON object per line. format csv: the CSV lines of this page (no header line; see header).

columns.description: The columns of the dataset (declared, else the keys of the records read so far), in the order csv cells follow.

header.description: format csv: the header line (the columns, CSV-escaped), the same on every page; write it once before the pages.

encoding.description: Binary payload encoding when data is returned inline.

data.description: Bounded Base64 binary payload for the current cursor page.

outputSchema.description: Bounded structured, paged-text or binary artifact read result. Oversized structured data in format records fails with export instructions.
